modeling_conclusion: No county numeric replacement. A subgroup-overlap calculation must explicitly assume consistent mutually exclusive person-level demographic labels across the participating school records; do not sum overlapping service-program groups. Unknown or inconsistent classifications cannot be silently assigned. State Male+Female completeness is not assumed.
